name: MonarchLanguageSelect
title: LanguageSelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (a .sheet with a List and .searchable) over BCP 47 tags, with names from Locale.localizedString(forIdentifier:) and tags canonicalised by Locale.identifier(.bcp47)
summary: A searchable picker for a language, each listed under its own name with its name in the interface's language below.
whenToUse: For the language of an account, a document or subtitles, where people look for their own language whatever the interface language is.
whenNotToUse: Not for the app's own language on iOS: send people to the app's page in Settings, where iOS manages per-app languages. For two or three languages, use a Picker.
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, languages: [String]? = nil, priority: [String] = [], locale: Locale? = nil, labelStyle: MonarchLanguageSelectLabelStyle = .endonym, showsTag: Bool = false, isRequired: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, labels: MonarchLanguageSelectLabels = MonarchLanguageSelectLabels())
struct MonarchLanguageSelectLabels { init(suggested: String? = nil, all: String? = nil, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels()) }

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen BCP 47 tag. Any form is read (EN-us); the picker writes the canonical tag (en-US).

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: languages
options.description: Limits the list to these tags, such as the languages the product is translated into. Invalid tags are dropped. nil lists about 80 common languages.

options.name: priority
options.description: Tags listed first under Suggested while nothing is typed, such as Locale.preferredLanguages.

options.name: locale
options.description: The interface's language: each row's second name and the sort order use it. The environment's locale when nil.

options.name: labelStyle
options.description: Which name each row shows first: the language's own name (Deutsch) or the interface's (German).

options.name: showsTag
options.description: Shows the tag at the end of each row.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while a language is chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces Suggested, All languages and the combobox strings; the combobox's empty text is built in as No languages match.

states.name: empty
states.description: The field shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the language's first name and a clear button when clearing is on.

states.name: suggestions
states.description: With priority and nothing typed, the list has a Suggested section and a section with the rest.

states.name: searching
states.description: The suggestions are hidden; matches are listed with labels that start with the query first.

states.name: no match
states.description: The list reads No languages match.

states.name: error
states.description: The field border and message use the danger colour, with an icon; the error is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Label, value and border use the disabled roles; the sheet does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's. Each row has the first name in the default text colour and the second name as a muted caption under it; the tag, when shown, is a muted caption at the end. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Names come from Foundation, which names regional variants as English (United Kingdom) where the web's Intl says British English. The web marks each endonym with its lang so screen readers switch voice; MonarchComboboxOption carries plain strings, so VoiceOver reads every name in the device's voice. The list opens in a sheet, as every MonarchCombobox does.
accessibility: The field is a button labelled with the label, whose value is the chosen row's label or None.
The help text, the error (read as Error: ...) and Required are the field's hint; a new error is announced.
The chosen row has the selected trait and a check mark, not colour alone.
Rows and the field are at least 44 points high.
Each row is read with both names, then the tag when it is shown.
VoiceOver reads names in the device's voice, not in the language they are written in.
edgeCases: Tags are canonicalised, so pt-br and PT-BR both choose pt-BR; strings that are not languages are dropped.
When both names are the same (English in an English interface), only one is shown.
Right-to-left names such as العربية are laid out by the text system inside a left-to-right row.
A selection outside languages is still listed first, so its name shows in the field.

examples.title: Endonyms with suggestions
examples.template:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    {{label}},
    selection: $language,
    helper: {{description}},
    languages: [{{languages.0}}, {{languages.1}}, {{languages.2}}, {{languages.3}}, {{languages.4}}, {{languages.5}}, {{languages.6}}, {{languages.7}}, {{languages.8}}],
    priority: [{{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"),
    showsTag: true,
    isClearable: false
)
examples.code:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    "Interface language",
    selection: $language,
    helper: "Each language is listed in its own name.",
    languages: ["ar", "de", "en", "es", "fr", "hi", "ja", "pt-BR", "zh-Hans"],
    priority: ["en", "es"],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"),
    showsTag: true,
    isClearable: false
)

examples.title: Interface names first, with tags
examples.code:
MonarchLanguageSelect(
    "Subtitles",
    selection: $language,
    prompt: "Choose a language",
    priority: ["en"],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"),
    labelStyle: .localized,
    showsTag: true
)
